spec_match.rationale: Implements the reschedule-and-watch workaround inside a worker and compares its output against what a real long-animation-frame entry would carry — the migration story.

interactive.rationale: Run and compare controls worked; the comparison table filled from the live workaround.

blurb_alignment.rationale: What-it-cannot-tell-you framing is exactly the comparison shown.

edge_cases.rationale: Costs, blind spots (no attribution, no script breakdown) and the detection threshold are all explicit.

runtime_evidence.rationale: Workaround ran in a real worker and detected the stall; console clean.

accessibility.rationale: Controls named, comparison textual, visible focus.

summary: Verified on headless Chromium 153 (Chrome for Testing 153.0.8010.12) driven over CDP via a Playwright script — chrome-devtools-mcp is unavailable in this cloud environment; desktop 1280×800 and mobile 360×740 DPR3 screenshots captured and inspected. A genuinely useful workaround demo that motivates the real API by its gaps.
